data.desc: Eastern International Ltd. (NASDAQ: ELOG) is a holding company incorporated in the Cayman Islands. The Company, through Hangzhou TC-Link Logistics Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. ('Hangzhou TC-Link'), Suzhou TC-Link Logistics Co., Ltd. ('Suzhou TC-Link') and its subsidiaries, all wholly owned subsidiaries of the Company, provides domestic and cross-border professional logistic services including project logistic and general logistic and, through Guizhou Tianrun Zhi Cheng Construction Engineering Co., Ltd., also a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, provides construction services for new energy infrastructure construction projects. Suzhou TC-Link was established on January 9, 2006, in Jiangsu Province, China. Suzhou TC-Link has obtained the internationally recognized IS09001 certificate of high-quality service (2015 standard).
